primitives.name: Tier-Based Merge Protocol
primitives.verbatim_quote: ## Hard wall — reject non-book inputs `freeTier` label alone is **not** trusted.
primitives.assumptions: Only book-market-state lines are valid for inclusion in SituationSnapshot.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When a `freeTier` lacks `book` qualification, it is rejected outright.

layer2.mapping: Maps to GSI's probabilistic belief update mechanism where each tier contributes a likelihood weight based on provenance grade.
layer2.telemetry: Source rejection rate and tier validation success metrics.

primitives.name: Conflict Resolution Rule
primitives.verbatim_quote: **Apify last** — **Tier-B market-state only** (never cite as provenance; never live-gate) **Rule:** earlier tier **always keeps** the line on conflict; later tiers fill gaps only.
primitives.assumptions: Earlier tiers have higher authority in case of conflicting lines.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Conflicts between tiers result in retention of earlier-tier line.

layer2.mapping: Derives into GSE's state-transition function that resolves inconsistencies by prioritizing temporal and hierarchical precedence.
layer2.telemetry: Frequency of conflict events and resolution outcomes per tier.

primitives.name: Stale Divergence Flag
primitives.verbatim_quote: A substantially fresher later tier only emits a `stale_higher_tier` divergence flag — **no overwrite**.
primitives.assumptions: Later tiers may indicate staleness but do not override earlier data.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Freshness-based divergence triggers alert without altering existing state.

layer2.mapping: Used in GSE to detect temporal inconsistency in quote streams and trigger revalidation protocols.
layer2.telemetry: Number of stale flags emitted and time-delta between tiers.
